# deps: tools: up fzf to 0.32.1

Pin `fzf` (the fuzzy finder, built from source in the Go toolset) at 0.32.1; the release notes are the [0.32.1 tag](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf/releases/tag/0.32.1). fzf's tags have no `v` prefix, so Go modules cannot resolve them ([junegunn/fzf#2917](https://github.com/junegunn/fzf/issues/2917)); the "pin" had to be the pseudo-version of the tagged commit.
